Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: Nexus Core MVP1 specification documents

Complete specification suite for TTRPG knowledge ingestion and AI query system:
- Architecture documents \(system, ingestion, UI wireframes\)
- Requirements and acceptance criteria
- Database schema with pgvector support
- API contracts \(OpenAPI, JWT\)
- Governance flow and artifact contracts
- Test plans, cases, and validation strategy
- Implementation agent prompts
- Phase maps and dependency chains

No implementation code - planning and specification phase complete.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

[PHASE0-INIT] Phase 0: Project & Governance Foundations

Implements Phase 0 of Nexus Core MVP1 - infrastructure foundation that 
blocks all subsequent phases.

Why:
- Establishes database schema, Docker orchestration, and governance
- Satisfies Phase 0 acceptance criteria from ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_v1.0.md
- Enables Phase 1+ development to proceed

Deliverables:
- PHASE0-INIT-001: Alembic migration tooling with pyproject.toml
- PHASE0-INIT-002: Database schema \(12 tables with pgvector, indexes, FK cascades\)
- PHASE0-INIT-003: Docker Compose \(6 active services, 2 deferred for Phase 0\)
- PHASE0-INIT-004: Transfer Station initialization script \(idempotent\)
- PHASE0-INIT-005: Environment variable template \(.env.example\)
- PHASE0-INIT-006: Health check endpoints \(GET /health with 4 checks\)
- PHASE0-INIT-007: Governance state machine + T-ING-001 test

Aligned Docs:
- DATABASE_SCHEMA_v1.0.md \(12 tables\)
- DATABASE_CONSTRAINTS_v1.0.md \(ON DELETE CASCADE rules\)
- DEPLOYMENT_v1.0.md \(services, startup order\)
- GOVERNANCE_FLOW_v1.0.md \(state machine, transitions\)
- TOOL_VERSIONS_v1.0.md \(minimum versions\)
- REQUIREMENTS_v1.0.md FR-001, FR-002, FR-003
- TEST_CASES_v1.0.md T-ING-001
- ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_v1.0.md Phase 0

EOF
\)")
